scientific_integrity: The analytic argument proves the global norm, essential norm, strict nonattainment and all finite-rank trace formulas. Exact-arithmetic checks are corroborative only. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the symmetric two-coordinate cone, standard Gaussian variance and total-degree cutoff are considered. Wider cone slopes, other Fock weights and higher-dimensional cones are unproved. Historical priority needs independent literature checking.
title: A sharp coordinate commutator and an exact finite-energy defect for the Fock bisector cone
